Integration questions, answered.

What syncs, how often, and what each system needs.

Q: Which systems does INGENIOUS.BUILD integrate with? A: QuickBooks Online, Xero, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and Yardi Voyager. For any other system, our custom accounting integration sends your approved records to an address you choose.

Q: What syncs, and how often? A: After approval, you send a record with one click. Invoices sync to every system. Contracts, change orders, budgets and budget changes also sync to Yardi Voyager, Sage Intacct and the custom integration. QuickBooks Online also takes contracts and change orders, and Finance & Operations also takes contracts. Paid status, vendors, cost codes, projects and GL accounts come back about every 4 hours, and five times a day for Sage Intacct. Sync now refreshes vendors, projects and cost codes on demand, and Sync payment status checks paid status right away. With the custom integration, your own system reports payments back through our API.

Q: Does INGENIOUS.BUILD have an API? A: Yes. Pro includes access to our public API, so your own tools, or a partner, can connect to INGENIOUS.BUILD. The custom accounting integration uses it to send payments, vendors and cost codes back. To connect Claude, ChatGPT or another AI, Pro also includes a native MCP server, and built-in AI works for every user without connecting anything.

Q: Is a Job Cost module required? A: For Yardi Voyager, Job Cost is on by default and needed for jobs, cost codes, contracts, change orders, budgets and retainage. Without it, invoices still sync, coded by property and GL account. Sage Intacct needs the Construction subscription with Projects, plus General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Purchasing.

Sage Intacct integration questions

Setup, sync timing and what is supported.

Q: Are you adding more functionality to this integration? A: We are continuously evaluating and adding new fields to our integrations. If you have a critical field you need added in order to make this integration function, please reach out to our team at support@ingenious.build.

Q: Which Sage Intacct modules are required? A: Sage Intacct Construction, meaning the Projects module with the Construction subscription, plus General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Purchasing. The Purchase Order, PO Change Order and Vendor Invoice transaction definitions must be set up under their standard names. Cost codes used on contracts, change orders and contract invoices must be standard cost codes with an item set in Sage Intacct.

Q: Do I need middleware or a connector? A: No. INGENIOUS.BUILD talks to Sage Intacct directly through the Sage API, with nothing to install or keep running. You connect by signing in on Sage Intacct's own login page and clicking Allow, so we never see your password.

Q: How often does the integration process information? A: Budgets, contracts, change orders and invoices go to Sage Intacct when a user clicks Sync to Sage Intacct on the approved record. Projects, cost codes, GL accounts and vendors come in from Sage Intacct five times a day, or right away with Sync now. Paid status of synced invoices is checked five times a day. Sync now can be used once every 5 minutes, and not between midnight and 2 a.m. Pacific.

Q: Are there any notable unsupported items with this integration? A: Multi-currency, VAT/GST, user-defined dimensions, cost types, invoice attachments, invoices you send to clients, and changes to a contract after it has synced are not supported. Payments are not sent to Sage Intacct (paid status comes back), and direct job costs are not imported from it.

Q: How is retainage handled? A: Retainage held on contracts and contract invoices is sent to Sage Intacct. Invoices without a contract carry no retainage. Releasing retainage is done in Sage Intacct.

Q: Will the integration sync previous project data? A: Projects, Companies, and Cost Codes can be linked between INGENIOUS.BUILD and Sage Intacct regardless of their start date, and a project budget can be imported from its Sage Intacct project estimate. Existing approved invoices and executed contracts and change orders can be synced once their project, vendor and cost codes are linked.

Q: Is the Yardi Voyager Job Cost module required? A: It's on by default. Job Cost is needed for jobs, cost codes, contracts, change orders, budgets and retainage. Without it you can still send invoices and get paid status back. Invoice lines are then coded by property and GL account only.

Q: Is there a specific version of Yardi needed? A: The INGENIOUS.BUILD interfaces must be installed and enabled for your properties. Yardi's standard interfaces cover US and Canadian properties.

A rejection or reversal in Yardi doesn't come back to INGENIOUS.BUILD.

Q: How is retainage handled? A: With Job Cost, retainage is sent on each line. When invoices go as payables, retainage released on a later invoice is booked as its own release payable.

Q: Will the integration sync previous project data? A: Yes. Projects, vendors and cost codes link regardless of start date. Nothing is sent in bulk. You sync each record you want, whatever its date, once it's ready: invoices and budgets when approved, contracts and change orders when executed. A change order goes after its contract, and a budget change after its budget. INGENIOUS.BUILD at a glance.

INGENIOUS.BUILD makes project management software for real estate development and construction. Owners, developers, contractors and designers run their projects on one platform, from pre-construction to closeout.

INGENIOUS.BUILD (IngeniousIO, Inc.)

Miami Beach, Florida, USA

About $45M raised, including a $37M Series A

Global, across North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America and the Middle East

Connected workspaces, no silos

Every company on the project gets its own connected workspace and keeps its own copy of what's shared. Data moves between them live, from the trade's pay app to the owner's funding, with no uploads, exports or email chains.

Priced per user

One per-user rate with unlimited projects, and external collaborators join free.

AI built in, MCP in Pro

Every user gets built-in AI. Connect your own AI through MCP, which is included in Pro, and it sees every party's shared data, live.

# Privacy Policy

**IngeniousIO, Inc.** (hereafter “Ingenious”, “we”, “our”, and “us”), also doing business as INGENIOUS.BUILD, is a company. We have developed a website and a suite of proprietary construction project management software applications, tools and service platform elements which we use to provide services to users on a ‘subscription as a service’(SaaS) basis (the “Service” or “Services”, as applicable). Our proprietary websites include but are not limited to https://www.ingenious.build (the “Website” or “Websites”). Also, please understand that, in this Policy, all visitors and users are addressed and referred to as “you”, “your”, and related terms.

**INGENIOUS respects the privacy rights of all individuals, wherever located.** For that reason, we have developed and posted this privacy policy (“Policy”) to explain our privacy-related practices to you. Please review this Policy carefully.

Next, please understand, that, in operating the Website and the Services, Ingenious may collect and process certain kinds of information from you and about you. The information so collected may vary depending on how you access and use our Website and Services, and this is explained in detail below. In all cases, by accessing and/or using the Website and/or the Services, and regardless of how you do so, you acknowledge and agree that you have read, understand, and agree to be bound by the terms of this Policy.

**If you do not agree with any of the terms in this Policy, please do not access or use the Website(s), the Services or any other part of our service offerings.**

If you have any questions or concerns about the terms of this Policy, please contact us at:<br />
